sentences.text: Rhomaleodus was a cartilaginous fish belonging to the class Chondrichthyes, which includes sharks and rays.
It is part of the Neoselachii group, and later research placed it within the Synechodontiformes rather than an uncertain position.
Andreev and Cuny first described the genus Rhomaleodus in 2012.
The type species, Rhomaleodus budurovi, serves as the name-bearing example for the group.
Currently, the Paleobiology Database records two distinct fossil occurrences of this animal.
Fossils of this genus date to the Middle Triassic period, specifically the Anisian stage found in Bulgaria.
Scientists have debated whether Rhomaleodus belongs in Synechodontiformes or remains in an uncertain placement within Selachii.
